audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer phase reasons are generic template text: 'Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war' is written for level 1, the stage the chart itself gives to Darius.
audit.why: Darius wins the early lane through Apprehend into Decimate and Hemorrhage stacks; Akali has only Q and no Shroud until 2.
audit.corrected: Each phase reason rewritten around the ability that actually owns that stage, with Apprehend's 26s rank-1 cooldown as the spine.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named no numbers and treated levels 3-5 as Akali's window.
audit.why: Darius's spikes are Apprehend rank-ups, level 6 Guillotine and 5 Hemorrhage stacks (Noxian Might); Akali's are Shroud at 2, first item, and 2 items.
audit.corrected: phases[3] now names Crippling Strike's 5s auto reset as the mid-lane tell; phases[5] and phases[6] key the all-in to the first-item timing inside the Apprehend gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions that decide this lane were absent: Decimate's outer-edge heal, Noxian Guillotine being true damage (so MR and Shroud both do nothing), and Crippling Strike being an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/_missing/akali.json lists all three for this matchup; the kit file flags Decimate heal, Noxian Guillotine trueDamage, Crippling Strike autoReset.
audit.corrected: Heal stated in phases[2].why, dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns; true damage in phases[4].why and report[5].t; the auto reset in phases[3].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Apprehend' appeared six times without ever saying how long it is down.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16 — a 26s hole at rank 1 is the single largest punishable window in the lane. Decimate is 9s, Crippling Strike 5s, Guillotine 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into winCon, phases[1], phases[5] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull and dontsFull descriptions were shared boilerplate that did not explain their own titles.
audit.why: Template copy — 'Fight at 5 stacks' was described as 'diving with no shroud and no energy'.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to its own title, naming Hemorrhage stacks and Noxian Might.

edits.before: Shroud his pull and out-scale him. Track Apprehend before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Shroud his pull and out-scale him. Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 — that gap is your whole lane.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Darius contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is his: Apprehend pulls you into a Decimate blade edge and bleed stacks. Last-hit at Q tip and concede the ground.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Darius's Apprehend is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts, but Apprehend is 26s — trade only inside that gap.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Darius must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Decimate's outer edge heals him per champion clipped — anti-heal is not optional in this lane.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Apprehend's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: Crippling Strike (5s) is an auto reset, so his wind-up — not the cast — is your cue to step out of range.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Darius's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts execute, but Noxian Guillotine (120s) is true damage and point-and-click — MR and Shroud both read zero on it.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Apprehend's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force the fight the moment it lands, inside his Apprehend gap.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Darius carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: E-flip in, R through for cast one, and cast two kills off missing health before five stacks matter.

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — His all-in start. Shroud-dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Apprehend (26s at rank 1): his all-in start and your only real window. - Decimate (9s): the outer edge heals him, so bring Grievous Wounds. - Noxian Guillotine (120s): true damage — MR and Shroud do nothing.

edits.before: Q Darius at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q him at 550 with Apprehend spent, E-mark and dash the angle, then Shroud his Decimate wind-up.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Standing inside 535 with Apprehend up — pull into Decimate and bleed is his whole kill pattern.

edits.before: Q Darius at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Vanish as the pull lands and his Decimate hits smoke, wasting a 26s cooldown for nothing.

edits.before: Darius wastes Apprehend (Pull) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Five Point Strike reaches 550 and Apprehend only 535 — chip from that edge.

edits.before: That is Darius's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Hemorrhage stacks are what fuel Noxian Might — deny the pull and he never gets there.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Decimate's outer edge heals him for every champion it clips.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: At five stacks Noxian Might empowers Decimate to heal him through your whole rotation.

edits.before: Track Darius's Apprehend (Pull): His all-in start. Shroud-dodge it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Apprehend (26s) is his all-in start — Shroud it. His Guillotine is true damage, so MR buys nothing.

notes: content whys[0..6] and content win[]/full phases[].side disagree at four of seven stages: the whys give Darius levels 1-5 and Akali the last two, while win[] and phases[].side read Darius/Skill/Akali/Akali/Darius/Akali/Akali. The whys match the packet levelChart and the prose, so the sides are the wrong half — but champion-name enums are too short to swap inside the +/-10% length band, so this needs a hand fix or a mirror-fix pass. I left the whys alone rather than degrade accurate prose to match a suspect chart.
